shows: New, with both reviews in mind. The check a data scientist would run first: what is usable, repeats, missing scores, how the scores spread across the scale (and where the model will be blind), and names removed. Uploaded labels come from unknown raters, so teachers re-rate a sample before they count, exactly as the starting rules are checked. The final exam never uses it. (Sample numbers.)
